A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human">In its depiction of Imperial society, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' makes it clear that only [[Human/Legends|Human]] families could be considered nobility, as they and [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith purebloods]] were the only [[Species/Legends|species]] considered "pure." Additionally, almost all Sith purebloods were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], with non-Force-sensitives like [[Krannus]] an extreme rarity, and all Force-sensitives were trained as Sith in the Empire.</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''nobleman''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was related to a [[Unidentified Sith Lord (noble relative)|respected Sith Lord]] fell out of favor during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As a result, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] arranged for the nobleman to be quietly escorted into exile, though the nobleman panicked, believing he was to be [[Death/Legends|killed]], and paid his escorts a large sum to ensure his survival.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Tough Love}}</ref>
